steps.what: Listen to individuals and identify their particular health care needs and access barriers

tasks.design: Keep personal listening and needs identification with the community health worker. Existing authorised information in {DOCS} may support the discussion; no new classification or case-note step is inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: Needs are often incomplete, sensitive and expressed indirectly.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting records does not replace understanding an individual's circumstances.
tasks.still_hard: An apparent health issue may reflect housing, language or trust barriers.
tasks.human_edge: The worker earns trust and checks their understanding with the individual.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in needs-identification time or clinical authority.

evidence.claim: Individual needs identification remains a contextual human interaction; no documentation saving is inferred from a case-note capability.

assumptions: Boundary is identifying needs through individual contact, excluding clinical diagnosis, eligibility decisions and separately maintained case records.
Individuals describe their circumstances within retained s1; existing health information is used only where authorised. No machine step requires structured health flags.
No new tool, data capture or upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
research_questions: Which needs require a qualified clinician or social-service specialist?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep. Personal needs identification remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise on health risks and prevention

steps.what: Advise clients or community groups on health risk and prevention using approved guidance

tasks.design: Retain the worker's prevention conversation using the existing approved guidance in {DOCS}. No generated advice or shorter client interaction is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: People need explanations suited to their circumstances and concerns.
tasks.enabler_now: Case-note generation does not establish reliable prevention counselling.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitive subjects, immediate concerns and misunderstanding require careful dialogue.
tasks.human_edge: The worker explains clearly, checks understanding and recognises when specialist support is needed.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in prevention-advice effort or clinical boundaries.

evidence.claim: Personal prevention advice remains human work; no record-writing or guidance-generation workload is added to this task.

assumptions: Boundary is explaining approved prevention guidance and responding to questions, excluding clinical treatment and separate material development.
Health education staff supply existing approved guidance upstream with unchanged effort. Client concerns are clarified inside retained s1, not converted into free structured risk labels.
No software change or new upkeep is proposed; incremental hours are zero.
research_questions: Which explanations need adaptation to improve client understanding?

already_counted.description: All prevention advice and understanding checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100, zero upkeep. Advice and understanding checks remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Build community relationships at meetings and health fairs

steps.what: Attend community meetings or health fairs, listen to issues and build relationships

tasks.design: Keep attendance, listening and relationship building with the worker. Existing programme information in {DOCS} can support participation without adding a new reporting workflow.
tasks.previous_blocker: Trust requires presence and repeated personal exchange.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool replaces participation in this task boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Some concerns are shared only after relationships develop.
tasks.human_edge: The worker becomes a familiar and accountable community contact.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in participation time or relationships.

evidence.claim: Attendance and community relationship building remain personal work; event administration is not assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is participation at the event, excluding organisation, invitations and later case records.
Organisers provide the existing programme and participants explain their concerns during retained s1. No machine action requires newly structured inputs.
No deployment or extra upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Community meeting formats and participation barriers
research_questions: Which groups are currently absent from these meetings?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep. No saving is assigned to unchanged community presence.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Give providers feedback on access and acceptability

steps.what: Provide health service providers feedback on accessibility, acceptability and practical improvements

tasks.design: Keep provider feedback and discussion with the worker, supported by existing permitted examples in {DOCS}. No new summary or automated disclosure is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Providers need context to understand community barriers.
tasks.enabler_now: Case-note drafting does not decide what feedback is representative or appropriate to share.
tasks.still_hard: The worker must represent experiences fairly while protecting individuals.
tasks.human_edge: The worker explains the community perspective and challenges impractical responses.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in feedback time or provider decision rights.

reach.learn: Accessible services and constructive provider feedback

evidence.claim: Provider feedback remains a contextual advocacy interaction; no separate report-production baseline is presumed.

assumptions: Boundary is communicating and discussing service feedback, excluding collecting case histories and provider implementation.
The worker selects permitted examples within the retained discussion effort; no new coded barrier dataset or machine-generated disclosure is assumed.
No implementation or new upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Permitted feedback channels and confidentiality rules
research_questions: Which examples can be shared without identifying individuals?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep. Contextual advocacy and provider discussion remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: These tasks retain personal attention and advocacy; documentation automation belongs to separately observed record duties.
reach: Support health educators with practical access-barrier feedback
Strengthen local referral relationships with service assistants
role.ambitious_version: A trusted community contact who listens, explains approved guidance and conveys practical service barriers.
